description: The socket is bound in the unit and the certificates are configured in daemon.json. dockerd only refuses a *single* option given in both places, so splitting them across the two files is legal and not unusual. CONTAINERS-0006 has to read both or it would report a mutually authenticated endpoint as an open one, which is a critical false positive on a host that did the work. Everything else the module reads is set to its hardened value too, log-driver included, so this is the fixture on which every CONTAINERS check must pass — a daemon check that had quietly started reading the unit shows up here as the one verdict that moved.
